name: POST /api/leadflow/calls/:id/disposition - close a call with its outcome, its NEXT and any voicemail
description:
EVERY CALL PRODUCES A CRM ACTIVITY WITH A DISPOSITION AND A NEXT (60720417-6bbe-4f69-97f4-18e8a6dfc1c0#AC3). The NEXT is required HERE rather than left to the save gate, because a call with no next action is precisely the record that goes quiet - and the moment the rep hangs up is the only moment they still remember what it should be.

THE VOICEMAIL AND THE ATTEMPT ARE ONE EVENT (60720417-6bbe-4f69-97f4-18e8a6dfc1c0#AC4). A transcript logged separately leaves a timeline with a call and an unattached transcript that a reader has to correlate by timestamp, which they will get wrong on a busy day. The attempt row is written and its id stored back on the call, so the two are linked in both directions.

A VOICEMAIL DOES NOT SATISFY THE RESPONSE SLA, and the attempt is written with satisfies_sla false to say so. Leaving a message is an attempt but not a conversation - the same rule the valid-human-attempt gate enforces, applied here so the two cannot disagree.

QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: Closing an unknown call is refused
NEGATIVE: a disposition with no NEXT is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: next_action is required - a call with no next action is the record that goes quiet
Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
